# Every command the workflow documentation shows, and what checks it here.
#
# A document that shows a command nothing runs is a document that stops being
# true without anybody noticing.

cargo test -p slingshot-development --test finite_state_machine_compatibility|the pin and its digests
cargo test -p slingshot-development --test finite_state_machine_handler|the operation-key contract
cargo test -p slingshot-development --test finite_state_machine_handler_validation|what a handler must say
cargo test -p slingshot-development --test finite_state_machine_success|what a success journals
cargo test -p slingshot-development --test finite_state_machine_failure|what a failure entitles
cargo test -p slingshot-development --test finite_state_machine_compensation|what undoing requires
cargo test -p slingshot-development --test finite_state_machine_artifact|where an answer goes
cargo test -p slingshot-development --test finite_state_machine_retry_idempotency|what a retry attaches to
cargo test -p slingshot-development --test finite_state_machine_daemon_restart|what a restart leaves alone
